subject: A wall-mounted assemblage of exactly four torn fabric fragments, charcoal, umber, bone, and faded red; the user asks for visible hand-mending at the actual joins.
prompt:
USER SUBJECT: A wall-mounted assemblage of exactly four torn fabric fragments, charcoal, umber, bone, and faded red; the user asks for visible hand-mending at the actual joins.
Preserve the user's requested identities, counts, setting, and layout. Add no default motifs.
VISUAL MEDIUM: textile_mixed_media
REPRESENTATION: stylized
APPLY THESE AUTHORED VISUAL RULES:
- [stitch-through-actual-seams] Place visible running stitches or short repair passes across the actual seam between requested fragments; make the thread visibly enter and leave the cloth and follow the seam's direction.
- [hand-repair-irregularity] Vary stitch length, spacing, and thread tension slightly; combine the seam with restrained fraying, folds, or a patch only where material stress supports it.
- [textile-relief-and-open-ground] Use folds, overlapped patches, and shallow cast shadows to show textile relief; leave broad quiet areas that reveal the fabric weave and prevent seams from covering the whole panel.
- [tactile-functional-mending] Make each repair physically bind the requested fragments, vary hand-sewn marks, and preserve textile relief and quiet ground.
REQUIREMENT: Activate only for user-requested textile assembly, visible repair, or mending.
REQUIREMENT: Preserve user-specified fragments, count, color, layout, and support.
REQUIREMENT: Make stitches cross actual joins with slight hand-made variation.
REQUIREMENT: Concentrate wear and relief at seams while keeping textile areas readable.

scope.description: An optional tactile assembly direction for user-requested textile or fabric fragments that are visibly repaired or joined. Uneven stitches cross actual raw seams, and patches or folds give the joins physical relief. The repair line becomes a local structural feature; it does not impose a personal memory, body, domestic setting, or symbolic narrative on the user's subject.
limitations: Enable only when the user requests a textile assembly, seam repair, or visible mending.
Preserve the requested fabric pieces, palette, count, layout, and support.
Place stitches on actual joins and vary their spacing and tension slightly.
Do not infer autobiographical memory or add needles, spools, clothing, bodies, spiders, or cages.
Do not copy a named work, textile composition, or installation.

rules.applies_when: The user requests fabric fragments joined, repaired, or visibly stitched.
rules.instruction: Place visible running stitches or short repair passes across the actual seam between requested fragments; make the thread visibly enter and leave the cloth and follow the seam's direction.
rules.observable: Stitches visibly bind two textile edges and read as construction rather than printed decoration.
rules.reject_when: Stitching floats on the surface, crosses unrelated areas, or forms a regular quilt grid not requested.
rules.avoid: decorative embroidery, regular grid stitching, and unsupported narrative symbols

rules.applies_when: The requested work emphasizes repaired or timeworn fabric.
rules.instruction: Vary stitch length, spacing, and thread tension slightly; combine the seam with restrained fraying, folds, or a patch only where material stress supports it.
rules.observable: The repair appears manually made and physically functional, with localized differences rather than uniform distress.
rules.reject_when: Every edge receives identical stitching, wear is applied globally, or thread no longer appears to hold the fabric.
rules.avoid: machine-perfect repeat, global grunge, and excessive loose threads

rules.applies_when: Fabric fragments are assembled on a wall, support, or other visible ground.
rules.instruction: Use folds, overlapped patches, and shallow cast shadows to show textile relief; leave broad quiet areas that reveal the fabric weave and prevent seams from covering the whole panel.
rules.observable: Cloth thickness, edge lift, and supporting ground remain distinguishable, with texture concentrated at joins.
rules.reject_when: Fabric reads as flat paper, relief becomes glossy CGI, or the whole surface receives equal microtexture.
rules.avoid: glossy plastic, uniform surface noise, and added wall objects

joint_checks.instruction: Make each repair physically bind the requested fragments, vary hand-sewn marks, and preserve textile relief and quiet ground.
joint_checks.observable: Seams, thread, cloth thickness, and support remain legible as one tactile assembly without a forced personal story.

review.note: Successful compilation is not image-quality validation or a maturity upgrade.
